name: Yogscast Dating Sim
source: A short visual novel about you (as the main character) starting at a new highschool called Yog High and possibly getting in a close relationship with one of the other students... There are 15 characters of which 14 are possible to end up with. All of these characters are real life people who are part the Yogscast, which is a company producing various Let's Play videos on multiple YouTube channels.
